body: A black t-shirt in a cotton blend, cut unisex, with a graphic on the front the listing describes as a galaxy shaped eye.
That description of the graphic is the listing's own. There is no photograph on this page for you to check it against, which is the honest position until we have one.
Not printed. The listing carries a single option with no size on it, no size chart and no garment measurements.
Ring the shop before you order. Somebody will lay one flat and read you the chest and the length off a tape, which is worth two minutes on a shirt at this price.
The fibre percentages in the blend, the fabric weight in grams per square metre, the printing method, the blank the shirt is printed on, and the country it was made in.
Every one of those is a row on the sheet below that says not printed. None of them have been guessed at.
Machine wash cold and hang to dry, as printed on the listing.
Sent out from 599 Smithdown Road, Liverpool, Tuesday to Sunday, or collect from the shop between 10 and 6, any day except Monday.

doctrine.h3: We publish the specification. We do not publish claims about what it does.
doctrine.p: On a garment the specification is the size chart, the fibre split, the fabric weight and the print method. This listing prints none of the four, so the sheet above says so four times rather than filling the rows with words that sound like measurements.

reiss.label: From Reiss
paras: A shirt at this price ought to arrive with a chest measurement, a fabric weight and the name of whatever it is printed on. This listing has none of the three, so the sheet says not printed four times: once for each of them, and once for the country it was made in. I would rather it said that than made a guess that turned up on somebody in the wrong size.

Ring the shop before you order if the fit matters, which it usually does. Somebody will take one off the pile, lay it flat and read you the numbers off a tape, and that is a better size chart than a table I invented for a web page.
